users.title: Users & access
users.description: Login accounts, role assignments and access. A user can hold several roles.
users.rolesHelp: Effective permissions are the union of all selected roles. Changes apply on the user's next request.
users.sessionsRevoked: User signed out of all sessions.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Permissions are stored in the database and enforced on the server for every request.
roles.counts: {permissions, plural, other {# permissions}} · {users, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}
roles.deleteDescription: Only roles with no assigned users can be deleted.

permissions.company_settings_manage: Edit company settings (name, logo, currency, timezone, work week)
permissions.role_manage: Create and edit roles and their permissions
permissions.user_manage: Invite users, assign roles, reset access, deactivate users
permissions.dashboard_hr: See HR dashboard metrics (headcount, joiners/leavers, pending items)
permissions.employee_read_team: View records of direct and indirect reports
permissions.employee_sensitive_read: View unmasked identity documents and bank details
permissions.leave_config_manage: Configure leave types, policies, public holidays and leave settings
permissions.leave_request_read_all: View every leave request and the company-wide leave calendar
permissions.leave_approve_team: Approve or reject leave for direct reports (or as a delegate)
permissions.leave_approve_all: Act on any approval step, including HR steps
permissions.leave_balance_adjust: Manually adjust leave balances (reason required, audited)
permissions.leave_report_read: Run leave reports and export balances
permissions.payroll_settings_manage: Manage pay components, proration, WPS and gratuity settings
permissions.payroll_salary_manage: Change salary structures and enter one-time adjustments
permissions.payroll_run_manage: Create, calculate, review, release and cancel payroll runs
permissions.payroll_run_approve: Approve payroll runs calculated by someone else (maker-checker)
permissions.payroll_run_reopen: Reopen a released payroll run (reason required, audited)
permissions.payroll_export: Export WPS SIF, bank transfer files and payroll registers
permissions.payroll_settlement_manage: Calculate and approve end-of-service gratuity and final settlements

SUPER_ADMIN.name: Super Admin
SUPER_ADMIN.description: Full access including company settings and roles

HR_ADMIN.name: HR Admin
HR_ADMIN.description: Employees, departments, leave policies, all leave requests, documents

PAYROLL_ADMIN.name: Payroll Admin
PAYROLL_ADMIN.description: Salary structures, payroll runs, payslips, exports

MANAGER.name: Manager
MANAGER.description: View own team (direct and indirect reports), approve team leave

EMPLOYEE.name: Employee
EMPLOYEE.description: Own profile, own leave, own payslips, directory and org chart

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change to sensitive data: who, what, when, before/after values and IP address.
audit.search: Search summary, action or entity id…

settings.title: Company settings
settings.description: Identity, locale and payroll calendar defaults. Changes are audited.
settings.logoDescription: Shown in the navigation and on payslips. PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB.

sections.localeDescription: Dates are stored in UTC and shown in this timezone.
sections.employeeNumbersDescription: Example: {example}. Applies to new employees only.

errors.superAdminLocked: The Super Admin role is locked and always has every permission.
errors.roleInUse: Remove this role from all users before deleting it.
errors.alreadyActivated: This user has already activated their account. Use password reset instead.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask HR to send a new one.
errors.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.cannotChangeOwnRoles: You cannot change your own roles.
errors.grantExceeds: You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself ({roles}).
errors.superAdminOnlyGrant: Only a Super Admin can grant or remove the Super Admin role.
errors.superAdminRequired: At least one active Super Admin is required.
errors.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.superAdminOnlyToggle: Only a Super Admin can enable or disable another Super Admin.
